reviews.text: I have been coming back to Amber's for a few years. I have tried elsewhere, but I don't anymore. Amber and her team has consistently done a fantastic job efficiently for a very fair cash price.
reviews.author: Roger Brocksmith

reviews.text:
I like the place and the staff. They are so friendly and professional.

They are fast, but good fast.

Their prices are very reasonable. I will go there every time I have to do a haircut 💇.
reviews.author: Fahad Haddadi (Shool)

reviews.text: Great barber in downtown Eugene. Super reasonable prices and my haircut was great!
reviews.author: Stephen Day

reviews.text: Really nice stylists and great with nervous young boys!
reviews.author: Author KDLumsden

reviews.text: Every time I've had my haircut here it's been a great experience. Even when there's 2 to 4 people ahead of me it's always been quick and efficient . And the prices are Very fair.
reviews.author: Patrick Simmonds
